title: Nairobi Retail Holdings orders 200 units of Tumaini Gold Cooking Oil 5L with ample stock available
description: Nairobi Retail Holdings requests 200 units of Tumaini Gold Cooking Oil 5L. The account manager, Dennis Omondi Owuor, checks availability at Nairobi Distribution Centre before confirming the order.
businessContext: SALES-POL-001 requires a sales order to pass stock availability and credit controls before it becomes a warehouse instruction.

events.event: Nairobi Retail Holdings requests 200 units of Tumaini Gold Cooking Oil 5L.
Dennis Omondi Owuor creates a quotation in Microsoft Dynamics 365 Sales.
Microsoft Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management confirms stock availability at the fulfilling warehouse.
The order is confirmed and reserved against inventory.

expectedOutcome: The order can be confirmed: quantityAvailable (1140) at Nairobi Distribution Centre comfortably exceeds the requested quantity (200) and remains above the reorder level (300) after reservation.
relevantFacts: Nairobi Retail Holdings (CUS-001) is managed by Dennis Omondi Owuor (EMP-0017).
Tumaini Gold Cooking Oil 5L (PRD-001) at Nairobi Distribution Centre (WH-NRB-001) has quantityOnHand 1200, quantityReserved 60, quantityAvailable 1140, reorderLevel 300 (inventory record INV-0001).
requiredReasoning: Resolve the customer to its account manager.
Resolve the requested product and its inventory position at the relevant warehouse.
Compare the requested quantity with quantityAvailable.
Confirm the order can be fulfilled without breaching the reorder level.
